svg.desc: CosyVoice-300M factorial over the acoustic prompt and the speaker embedding at the language model and the decoder. Without the prompt, removing either site costs similarity and the losses add, down to 0.14 with neither. With the prompt, removing the language-model embedding changes nothing while removing the decoder embedding still costs about 0.06 to 0.07.
